desc: 冷银石台开场、大理石展台与靛紫编号分栏的小宠沙发窝详情长图款
leaf: 仓鼠等小宠用迷你沙发造型绒面睡窝
name: 仓鼠迷你沙发窝小宠睡窝款

shots.intent: 用冷银渐变加一块斜切大理石展台开场，先立住整套色系并给出一个可买理由。
shots.textZone: upper-left filled pill tag, two-line headline, small-caps eyebrow at upper right, lower-left row of three outlined pill tags

shots.intent: 把六条设计主张压进一张白卡的等分格网，手机端一屏读完建立做工印象。
shots.textZone: card headline block above the grid, six labels in the grid cells

shots.intent: 换成近黑分区带放大趴卧不适的问题，再用三枚白描圆窗把视线收回到窝的结构上。
shots.textZone: accent-led two-line headline above the rings, three caption labels below

shots.intent: 左右两个 90 度侧面裁切中间放一个约等号，用同料同形说明两侧一致性。
shots.textZone: centre relation glyph, one outlined pill label under each half

shots.intent: 把窝放回真实笼内环境，让买家代入自家小宠的睡眠角落。
shots.textZone: one small caption chip lower left plus one short outlined label under it

shots.intent: 用绒面与格缝的微距质感承担做工证明，替代无法验证的数据。
shots.textZone: right-hand column of three label blocks with pill captions

shots.intent: 用四段编号分栏逐条讲结构，每段配一个不同机位，把长文卖点拆成可下滑的台阶。
shots.textZone: one numbered block per panel plus one legend line per panel

shots.intent: 俯视平铺两台镜像加三块材质小样，让买家一次完成规格选择。
shots.textZone: one caption pill under each unit and one label under each material chip

shots.intent: 大标题配细分割线的双栏交错细节，把三个细节点讲成有节奏的段落。
shots.textZone: section title, three title-plus-subline detail blocks alternating left and right

shots.intent: 用三列细线参数表承接最后的选择疑虑，数值全部留白等运行时填。
shots.textZone: section headline, three column headers, three rows of table cells

shots.intent: 回到首屏的冷银石台收束整套，留一枚按钮位完成详情长图的行动闭环。
shots.textZone: top headline plus one rounded button beneath the product

style.backgroundSystem: seamless cool silver-grey gradient studio panels in #E3E6EA with one angled polished white marble display slab #FFFFFF carrying pale grey veining #C8CDD4; infographic screens switch to rounded white cards #FFFFFF on the same silver, with full-width near-black bands #14161A and lavender field blocks #E7EAF6 as the only alternates
style.direction: cool silver studio small-pet bedding detail page
style.iconSystem: thin-line geometric glyphs in #5B4CE4 inside outlined squares and circles, one small paw glyph as the recurring marker, identical stroke weight and corner radius across the whole set, no 3D icons and no filled pictograms
style.lightingSystem: cool 6000K soft diffused key from the upper right, low contrast, broad wrap, restrained marble reflection, gentle contact shadow that always touches the ground plane; macro and structure screens add one raking accent to reveal the quilted grid; no warm cast anywhere
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium small-pet bedding ecommerce visual system across the entire detail-page set; fixed palette of cool silver-grey studio panel #E3E6EA, pure white infographic card #FFFFFF, near-black section band #14161A, soft lavender field block #E7EAF6 and one indigo accent #5B4CE4, with the indigo-to-violet gradient #5B4CE4 to #8A5BEA allowed only inside flat numbered blocks; cool tone throughout with no warm cast; modern heavy geometric Chinese sans-serif headlines paired with one small-caps latin eyebrow line in #6B7076 and one hairline rule under every section title; consistent background system of seamless cool silver panels plus one angled polished white marble slab #FFFFFF with pale grey veining #C8CDD4, switching to rounded white card grids on the same silver with full-width near-black #14161A and lavender #E7EAF6 bands as the only alternates; cool 6000K soft diffused key from the upper right, low contrast, broad wrap, restrained marble reflection, gentle contact shadows that always touch the ground plane, one raking accent on macro views only; surface system of polished marble, matte plush ribbed quilted fabric with stitched grid seams and a rolled bolster arm, pale neutral paper substrate #E4E6E2 in scene views only; layout system of left-aligned headline block, one filled indigo pill tag, rows of outlined pill tags, hairline-divided icon grids, white outline ring crops, one ≈ relation glyph, alternating numbered blocks, two-column detail blocks and a hairline-ruled three-column spec table; thin-line icon style in #5B4CE4 inside outlined squares and circles with one small paw glyph marker at identical stroke weight; product presented flat on a plane at a stable slight 3/4 angle established in the opening screen, scale never changing between shots; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no gradient outside the numbered blocks, no invented numbers, units, material grades or certification marks unless supplied at generation time.
noDrift: no indigo-to-violet gradient outside the flat numbered blocks
no human-scale furniture or human living-room interiors in any panel
no warm colour cast anywhere in the set
no real numbers, units, material grades, breed names or certification marks unless supplied at generation time
style.presentationRules: the bed always sits flat on a plane with a visible contact shadow, never floating; the slight 3/4 angle set in the opening screen is reused as the anchor view; bolster roll, grid stitching and base edge stay geometrically identical between shots; product scale stable, only the crop changes
style.surfaceSystem: polished marble slab with pale grey veining, matte plush ribbed quilted fabric with stitched grid seams and a rolled bolster arm, pale neutral paper substrate #E4E6E2 in scene views only
style.typography: modern heavy geometric Chinese sans-serif for headlines plus one small-caps latin eyebrow line in #6B7076 with a single hairline rule beneath every section title; Chinese copy always wrapped in 「」 and always a placeholder
